paragraphs: Chiyya of Hormin—Hormiz Ardashir: chapter Chezkat HaBatim, 52a. He related to Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak in Rav Nachman's name; see there. It should read that Rav Acha bar Yaakov related it to him in the name of Rav Nachman bar Yaakov; see there.
